title: Claude Copilot Agent Manifest
description: Declarative source of truth for agent roster, routing edges, and tool grants

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last manifest generation

agents.description: Map of agent name to agent descriptor

role.description: framework = counted in the 16; setup-only = utility, not counted

methodology.description: Named industry methodology embedded in this agent

iteration.description: The agent's iteration contract: how it behaves across re-invocation -- the checkpoint 'request changes' loop (.claude/commands/protocol.md, section 'Iteration Handling (Change Requests)'), premature-stop continuation (same file, 'Continuation Detection'), and the gate it must clear before emitting a completion promise. Optional on AgentDescriptor because role=setup-only agents (e.g. kc) run a linear discovery flow with no re-invocation loop and legitimately carry none. Required for every role=framework agent -- enforced by the frontmatter conformance check (FF7 in fitness-check.sh), not by this schema alone, since that is a cross-field rule (depends on `role`) that JSON Schema draft-07 expresses badly. This same subschema also governs each agent .md's YAML frontmatter `iteration:` block, so the two representations cannot drift apart.

enabled.description: Whether this agent participates in the re-invocation/iteration loop at all

maxIterations.description: Ceiling on re-invocations for one task before the loop must stop and escalate to the user; the framework's own runaway protection blocks at >10 continuations, so this is a per-agent budget under that ceiling

completionPromises.description: The exact promise markers this agent may end a turn with; protocol.md's Continuation Detection auto-resumes the agent when a turn ends without one of these

validationRules.description: Named predicates that must hold before this agent may emit <promise>COMPLETE</promise> -- the acceptance gate for its own iteration loop

optional.description: True if this route is optional/conditional
